boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 75 uses a cross-shaped board with stepped pixelated edges — not the usual rectangle. Blocks are packed in both the upper and lower arms of the cross, connected only through a center junction. Clear the upper arm first to open the junction, then route the lower arm's heavy blocks through the widened center to the bottom exits.
landmarks: Block Out Level 75 uses a cross-shaped board with stepped pixelated edges — not the usual rectangle.
Blocks are packed in both the upper and lower arms of the cross, connected only through a center junction.
Clear the upper arm first to open the junction, then route the lower arm's heavy blocks through the widened center to the bottom exits.

quickTips: The center junction is the only path between the upper and lower arms — clear it early.
Feed the lower arm's heavy blocks last when the center has the most room.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the small green blocks near the upper arm tips through the side exits.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Extract the framed block from the center junction to open the crossing point.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Pull the remaining red and yellow blocks from the upper arm through the top or side exits.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Route the first lower-arm blocks (purple and orange) through the opened center junction.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Feed the larger yellow and blue blocks from the lower arm through the bottom exits.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the high-counter blocks that need the most passes through the bottom.

failurePoints: Trying to route lower-arm blocks through the center before the upper arm is cleared — the junction jams.
Ignoring the framed block in the center junction, which gates all traffic between the two arms.
